title: fix(ui): Systems repeats recovery advice during reconnect
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: Systems repeats the same reconnect instruction across the page and Backups, while also telling users to refresh devices when the Gateway is disconnected.

## User Impact

User impact: reconnecting has one clear recovery explanation. Device details still report Offline, and the normal desktop and backup states return after reconnect. Real inventory, backup, permission, and setup errors remain. Connection behavior, permissions, data retention, and requests are unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing workspace state already explains the lost connection. The duplicate overview notice and disconnected backup sections add no useful action, and the online-only refresh hint cannot help until connectivity returns. Both backup callers now leave connection recovery to the workspace, removing the unused backup-specific offline branch.

## Evidence

Real Control UI with synthetic mock-Gateway inventory, disconnected and reconnected through the mock transport. Light theme; emulated 1280×900 and 390×900 viewports. Red rectangles mark redundant instructions before and the single useful recovery explanation after.

**Before**

![Before: Systems repeats reconnect guidance and offers premature refresh advice](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3f06f43c-5a87-4f10-adcf-a9ddddb94ec6)

**After**

![After: Systems keeps one connection-recovery explanation](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/eff0c365-8d08-4a8b-ba87-ddf28474f98a)

<details>
<summary>Phone comparison</summary>

**Before**

![Before on phone: duplicate reconnect notice and unusable refresh advice](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ceff2a96-8c7e-4080-a03b-83435fac03b8)

**After**

![After on phone: one recovery explanation with Device details preserved](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7cc6c051-bc0f-451c-a1a7-7ad096a8eac9)

</details>

- Both regressions fail on main baseline e33981dc1462f63c63c13513cf1f74ecd8726dc1 and pass after the fix. They open Device details while disconnected, verify Offline, reconnect, and verify the normal desktop/backup states return.
- Two focused browser cases passed (15.93 seconds including setup); the other 24 cases in that file were not selected. Systems page/data/refresh-failure unit suites: 35 passed (2.28 seconds), including real backup failures, permissions, stale-response retirement, and view-only desktop lifecycle. UI types, focused lint, formatting, and diff checks passed. Broad PR CI is not claimed complete.
- History: the duplicate workspace notice dates to #147519 and was retained by the Solid migration in #168871. No new banner, copy, state owner, or stylesheet is added; production net −5 lines.
- Self-review and pr-simplify complete. Independent automated review remains outstanding. This draft is for Vyctor’s review, not authorized for merge.

Requested and guided by @vyctorbrzezowski; implemented by RoboClaw.
